rachel: Support flagged a 404 in pricing (old anchor /pricing#usage-tiers) and the metering headers doc still shows Authorization: Bearer + legacy method names. can someone take a quick patch?
dan: i'll handle. plan: add redirects.yml entry for the old pricing anchor -> new /pricing#usage-consumption, update /docs/metering/headers.md to recommend x-api-key, and swap snippets to client.generate(...) across py/ts.
mina: also add a tiny worked example for burst tokens: "burst_tokens = burst_rate_per_min * minutes" with a numeric example (1000 * 15 = 15,000). include a one-line python helper.
dan: noted. draft python helper: `def est_burst(rate, mins): return rate * mins  # ex: est_burst(1000,15) -> 15000`
docs-bot: PR #4621 opened by dan — "docs: pricing anchor redirect + metering header snippets". Reviewers requested: @mina, @rachel. CI: pending.
rachel: prefer adding redirects so external links remain valid. please backport to docs-1.2 after main merge; a few enterprise customers still point there.
dan: will add redirect entry, a small redirect unit test (run locally before pushing), a short migration blurb, and a changelog note. aiming to merge today.
